description: Call qt_documentation_search when: (a) you're about to claim a signal/slot/property/default exists, (b) the API is in Qt 6.7+ or a non-core module (MQTT, OPC UA, Network Auth, etc), (c) the user used the words 'docs', 'official', 'verify', or 'check'. Skip when: the question is about basic QString/QObject/signal-slot syntax.

filter.description: Optional: Filter by document type. One of 'all', 'class', 'qml', 'function', 'guide'. Default is 'all'. Note: 'function' returns the class reference page that contains the function (there are no function-level pages); for QML, use 'qml'.

intent.description: Optional: Prioritizes (not filters) results by type. One of 'api', 'tutorial', 'guide', 'concept', 'example', 'migration'. 'api'=class reference, 'tutorial'=how-to guides, 'guide'=overviews, 'concept'=explanations, 'example'=code samples, 'migration'=porting guides.

keywords.description: Optional: Array of keywords to search for. Results match ANY keyword. Example: ["button", "signal", "connect"]. Alternative to 'query' for better multi-term matching.

max_results.description: Optional: Maximum number of results to return (1-10). Default is 3.

module.description: Optional: Limit search to specific Qt module (e.g., 'qtcore', 'qtwidgets', 'qtqml', 'qtquick', 'qtnetwork')

product.description: Optional: Limit search to a specific documentation product (e.g. 'qt', 'qtcreator', 'pyside6'). Omit to search all products.

query.description: Search query for Qt documentation (e.g., 'Animation', 'QTimer', 'signal slot'). Optional if 'keywords' is provided.

version.description: Optional: Qt version to search (e.g., '6.10.0', '6.9.0'). Defaults to latest installed version if not specified.

name: qt_documentation_search
